exposure: Mode of delivery (spontaneous vaginal delivery, emergency cesarean section, vacuum extraction, elective cesarean section)
finding: Obstetric intervention, including emergency cesarean section and vacuum extraction, was associated with increased odds of reporting dyspareunia at 18 months postpartum.
mod_finding: Compared to women who had a spontaneous vaginal delivery, those who had an emergency cesarean section, vacuum extraction, or elective cesarean section had increased odds of reporting dyspareunia at 18 months postpartum.
